_comment: Car-seat stroller adapter fragment. Batch S4 (Joolz/M&P/Mima). Sourced 2026-07-05. Do NOT edit seed.json.
name: Mamas & Papas Armadillo Flip/XT & Ocarro Maxi-Cosi/Cybex Car Seat Adaptors
seatBrandsSupported: Maxi-Cosi / Cybex / Joie (per M&P listing). Clek's official list attests the Liing fits the Ocarro via this adapter — the Liing shares the Maxi-Cosi infant-seat footprint, though M&P's product name does not spell out 'Clek'.
_priceNote: M&P price is £29 (GBP). US retailer listings run ~$31.95–$39.95. M&P largely withdrew from the US market, so US availability is via third-party retailers.

install.notes: Click-on adapters for the Armadillo Flip/XT and Ocarro/Ocarro 2 chassis; infant carrier clicks in facing the parent.

notes: One adapter part (159925300) serves the Armadillo Flip/XT and Ocarro/Ocarro 2. Fits the Maxi-Cosi footprint that the Clek Liing uses; Clek's authoritative list confirms Liing-on-Ocarro compatibility. Inexpensive (~£29 / $30–40) and in stock.
